subject.title: feat(ui): surface still-running background tasks after the chat turn settles

question: Should the Control UI adopt this persistent post-turn status row as the standard conversation-level signal for still-running background tasks?
rationale: The implementation is technically focused and proven, but the row's placement, animation, and persistence define a new user-facing chat UX and the protected maintainer label requires explicit acceptance.

options.title: Adopt after rebase
options.body: Resolve the current conflicts, preserve the reviewed accessibility and state-suppression behavior, rerun focused proof, and land the status row.

options.title: Keep rail-only UX
options.body: Decline the extra conversation-level row and continue relying on the existing tasks-rail toggle and badge.

recommendation.title: Adopt after rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflicts, preserve the reviewed accessibility and state-suppression behavior, rerun focused proof, and land the status row.
